title: Add the telemetry toggle to the settings page
description: The settings page needs a telemetry toggle persisted to localStorage, with its e2e case run. Note the page's current render embeds the raw token in a page attribute; the change is the chance to stop that.

criteria.text: the settings page exposes a telemetry toggle persisted to localStorage, e2e/settings.spec.js runs the case, and no page attribute carries the raw token.
